body: Two owner ideas landed this turn. (A) THE PROGRESSION (0221 message, decoded and formalized - full text in docs/LOOM-PENROSE-SIDE-QUEST-2026-10-29.md section 'L6 (0222)'): RDW a_0=2, a_{n+1}=a_n+2 t_n, t_n=min{t>=1: a_n+2t prime}. The dream (+1) always dies on the parity mirror (layer 0, the 50% anchor); the marks that survive are the primes. Between consecutive marks the misses split exactly in half: evens (killer 2, the anchor, the uniform +1-up pass) and odds (killer = spf >= 3, always an earlier mark - the look-back). 'Why 7 not 6?': 6 double-dead (parity + 3-audit). '-1 or +1?': +1 = anchor (uniform), -1 = information (the genealogy); the owner's -1 guess is right where the structure is. Honest boundary: faithful sieve re-expression, not a shortcut; expectation form = Cramer/sieve + the 0217 void field as class-conditional refinement. (B) THE SINGLE-FILE RENDERABLE: sq/LOOM-VIS.html - the owner asked for 'a side quest in a single file... renderable... with colors... plays like a fractal... decent controls for changing the angle, view, zoom, mouse controls'. Built: 774KB self-contained HTML (real primes embedded as int16/base64; generator scripts/sq/loom_vis_gen.py; template sq/LOOM-VIS-template.html; node --check clean; data integrity: p0+sum(gaps)==pL at every scale, all gaps even, anchored above 2). Views: TAPE (swirl tape, anisotropic streaks sigma_x ~ local median gap so the swirl stretches with the scale, 12-hue class wheel, red columns = the even parity mirrors = the visible 50% anchor; pan/zoom/tilt), WHEEL (BLOOM-24: front warm/back cool petals, antipode links, asymmetry rings, spin + breathing), WALK (RDW live: walker dot, +1 dream ticks, red mirrors, misses colored by killer genealogy, speed + play), WORD (gap-class chirality spiral, spin/zoom). The fractal play mode cycles the scale ladder 1e5/1e6/1e7/1e8: the measured scale-behavior IS the playback - meanGap 10.426/12.739/16.049/18.424, bloomAsym 0.09420/0.07659/0.06001/0.05268 (decays; consistent with 0218: 0.073@2e6 0.056@1e8), pairBias4 1.2501/1.2388/1.2095/1.1838 (decays; consistent with 0196 1.23@2e6), frontFrac 0.698/0.654/0.615/0.597. Bug found+fixed: including 2 in the small-scale windows made an odd gap (2->3 = 1) that breaks (g%24)/2 lane indexing - re-anchored all windows above 2 (the anchor is the boundary, not part of the weave). File sent to the owner via Telegram attach. (C) loom8b_aniso_tape.py (the anchored tape as a measurement machine: tropic k-th*/k-x*, unit-free aspect, spin table omega_r=2pi count_r/W_int, own-spin coherence C/L_c, own-spin next-class motor fidelity, 3-way metric phase 1: sig=(log aspect, w*, C, log Lc, P*) distances d(data,pair) vs the d(pair,pair) noise floor; validation requirement: it must re-split 0219 by itself - L8 small/married, G24 large/deeper) - running in background, results in 0223. All off-board; no RH claim; single-threaded; 4 cores open.
